formats.note: GEMDOS header is only an anchor. xx_larc_pfx_detect checks exact known PFX 1.13P instruction bodies, the end-of-TEXT DEADFACE marker and checksummed level-0 headers. It accepts DATA-bounded packed-size overruns or complete ordered member chains with restricted alignment/relocation tails. Only this validated producer permits its non-authoritative LZ5 CRC field.
